meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取进化树文件,比较树形差异、标注基因事件并画出可发表的树图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头已有现成的进化树文件,想比较拓扑、标注事件并出图。
copy.tagline_en: Read tree files, compare topologies, and draw publication-ready tree figures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a tree file and need comparisons, annotations, and publication figures

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能读写 Newick、NHX 等树文件，做修剪、重新生根和 Robinson-Foulds 比较，检测基因树的重复/物种化事件并分出直系同源组，连接 NCBI 分类库，渲染 PDF/SVG 图。
howto.when: 当你提供 Newick、NHX 等树文件、要求比较两棵树，或做直系同源与分类注释时接管；它不从原始序列推断树，需先比对建树。

say.text: 把这棵 tree.nw 重新生根，存成 Newick
say.note: 按中点生根并写出新树文件

say.text: 用 NCBI 分类库给这几个物种建一棵树
say.note: 按 taxid 连出最小分类树

howto.what_en: Claude can read and write Newick/NHX trees, prune, reroot and compare topologies with Robinson-Foulds, detect gene-tree duplication/speciation events, extract orthologs, query NCBI taxonomy, and render PDF/SVG figures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply tree files (Newick/NHX, etc.), ask to compare two trees, or want ortholog and taxonomy annotation. It does not infer trees from raw sequences.

say_en.note: Midpoint roots and saves the new tree

say_en.text: Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw with Robinson-Foulds
say_en.note: Reports RF distance and normalized value

say_en.text: Build a taxonomy tree for these species with NCBITaxa
say_en.note: Uses NCBI taxonomy to connect taxa
